title: JobEnvelope
description: A unit of work published by the API to exchange workbench.jobs with routing key jobs.<type>. Workers acknowledge on claim and report through JobEvent messages.

attempt.description: 1 for the first delivery; the sweep re-publishes with attempt+1

publishedAt.description: when this envelope was published; a cancel received before it does not apply to this delivery (retries)

payload.description: tool-specific; the worker must not need anything else
